name: AffiliNinja Lite
author: affilininja

sections.description:
AffiliNinja Lite gives affiliate marketers and bloggers a set of professional Gutenberg blocks to showcase products, write reviews, and drive conversions — all without touching any code.

Free blocks included:

  • Product Box — Display a product with image, title, price, description, and a call-to-action button. Perfect for Amazon and affiliate links.
  • Rating Box — Add a clean star rating summary to any review post.
  • Pros & Cons — Show a balanced pros and cons list that readers trust.

All blocks are designed to be fast, lightweight, and fully compatible with any WordPress theme.

Want more power? Upgrade to AffiliNinja Pro:

  • Comparison Table block — side-by-side product comparison
  • Top Pick Box block — highlight your #1 recommended product
  • Recommended Product block — stylish product highlight card
  • Product Image block — optimised affiliate product images
  • Amazon API auto-fill — automatically pull product title, image, and price from Amazon
  • Link cloaking — clean branded URLs (yoursite.com/go/product)
  • Click tracking dashboard with CSV export
  • AI article generation via Koala.sh
  • Save and reuse block templates
  • Priority support

Source Code

This plugin includes compiled JavaScript files (dist/index.js, vendor-bundle/index.js).
The complete source code is available at: https://affilininja.com/source/
All source code is licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the affilininja-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page in the Gutenberg editor.
  4. Click the + block inserter and look for the AffiliNinja category.
  5. Insert a Product Box, Rating Box, or Pros & Cons block.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the Classic Editor?

No. AffiliNinja Lite is built for the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). It requires WordPress 5.8 or higher.

What is the difference between Lite and Pro?

The Lite version includes three fully-functional core blocks with no restrictions. The Pro version adds four additional blocks, Amazon API auto-fill, link cloaking, click tracking, AI content generation, and priority support.

Is this compatible with my theme?

AffiliNinja blocks are designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme. The blocks use their own scoped CSS so they should not conflict with your theme styles.

Is there a setup wizard or API key required?

No. AffiliNinja Lite works immediately after activation with no API keys, no account registration, and no setup wizard required.
